correctness.rationale: For symmetric uniform-volume bodies the affine projector kernel is 1+x^T Sigma^-1 y. Convexity reduces norm evaluation to extreme points; cross-polytope marginal has density d/2(1-|t|)^(d-1) and variance 2/((d+1)(d+2)), giving exact single-integral expression. Cube evaluation is E|1+3 sum U_i| and the Irwin–Hall CDF gives exact alternating finite sum. Independently computed exact Fraction formulas for dimensions 1–12: equality only in 1,2 and ten strictly positive gaps 3..12. For all d>=13 cross norm >d/2>sqrt(1+3d)>=cube norm. Gaussian CLT plus uniform-integrability of scaled sums yields sqrt(6/pi) cube growth versus d/2 cross growth, hence sqrt(pi/24) limiting ratio.
